response.sql: WITH product_counts AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), product_shares AS (SELECT product_id, line_count, 1.0 * line_count / SUM(line_count) OVER () AS share FROM product_counts), overall AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM product_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ps.line_count), 0) AS combined_count, AVG(ps.share) AS average_share, AVG(ps.share - o.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM product_shares AS ps CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE ps.share > o.average_share

assumptions.assumption: If no product qualifies, the combined count is 0 and both averages are NULL.
